title: Cell
description: One unit of manager automation: trigger -> gather -> diff -> write -> gate -> land -> record. Harness-neutral. Company-specific values live in config and in the tools file, never in the cell body.

kind.description: writer produces a document through a skill and a gate; consumer reads other cells' ledgers; collector only fills a cache

component.description: graph partition this cell belongs to; the private one (default 'hr') is a separate connected component

workspace.description: required for the private component: the folder and memory partition the cell runs in

agent.description: Bot or agent template that should run this cell on harnesses that have one

events.description: event descriptions a heartbeat watches for, e.g. 'calendar item <Name> : <Me> | 1 on 1 minus 1 day'

role.description: namespaced capability, e.g. docs.read, chat.search, tasks.list; resolved through tools.json

ref.description: locator for the role (doc id, channel, query); may use ${config.x}

fixture.description: evidence file used by --dry-run, relative to the cell file
